notes: The typed sheet gives complements on Coxeter transformations, with an inserted irreducibility qualification and a handwritten reference to Kostant, th. 9.2. No date or authorial page number is visible; pencilled 1 at lower left is archival.
Statement a) relates eigenvalue orders to characteristic exponents and gives an order-h criterion. Its regular-eigenvector qualification includes a called marginal note about dimension 1.

The first corollary identifies the cyclic subgroup with its centralizer and states a normalizer-quotient isomorphism to its automorphism group. The margin asks which extension arises, and a slanted instruction refers to exchanging the corollary with cor. 3.

The proof uses a one-dimensional eigenspace, a map to scalar automorphisms, and a retraction. Its explicit obligations are “il faut prouver” and “Reste à prouver”; the latter is followed by “ce qui résulte également de Kostant”. No abandoned proof or explicit unproved assertion is marked.
The second corollary characterizes regular eigenvectors through primitive h-th eigenvalues and gives an order argument. The last corollary begins at the foot and continues off this assigned page.
The source c^h, qômme, conjugué de c and régulières are preserved. The tall h was rechecked because the preceding quantifier names n; no mathematical repair was substituted.

The bottom beginning has three rows, including a live middle Soit D une. The comma after D in “centralise D, et” is live and lies outside the earlier induit cancellation; no comma was added inside that cancellation.

The English reference is physically beneath the title, though represented with the supplied margin macro. H heading boldface was treated as a different emphasis convention, not as a lexical disagreement; the source headings have single underlines.
Where overlapping typewriter impressions do not identify a separate earlier word or correction order, the proposed final word remains doubtful rather than inventing a cancelled layer.
